```
<body>
  <div class="shell">
    <header class="topbar">
      <div class="wordmark"><span class="mark" aria-hidden="true">M</span> Materials Lab <span class="wordmark-separator" aria-hidden="true">/</span> Device Characterization</div>
      <div class="top-actions">
        <button class="theme-toggle" id="themeToggle" type="button" aria-label="Switch to dark mode">Dark mode</button>
        <div class="top-meta"><span class="live-dot" id="connectionDot"></span><span id="connectionLabel">SERIAL OFFLINE</span></div>
      </div>
    </header>

    <main>
      <section class="heading-row" aria-labelledby="pageTitle">
        <div>
          <p class="eyebrow">Bench console <span aria-hidden="true">/</span> MOSFET study</p>
          <h1 id="pageTitle">Voltage sweep</h1>
          <p class="subtitle">Applied and sensed voltage characterization</p>
        </div>
        <div class="run-index">RUN <span id="runNumber">--</span></div>
      </section>

      <section class="controlbar" aria-label="Serial controls">
        <button class="primary" id="startButton" type="button">Connect &amp; capture</button>
        <button class="secondary" id="stopButton" type="button" disabled>Stop</button>
        <button class="secondary" id="exportButton" type="button" disabled>Export CSV</button>
        <div class="serial-config"><span>PORT</span><strong>USB serial</strong><span aria-hidden="true">/</span><span>BAUD</span><strong>115200</strong></div>
        <div class="status" id="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"><span class="status-dot"></span><span id="statusText">Select the Arduino to begin.</span></div>
      </section>

      <section class="metrics" aria-label="Capture summary">
        <div class="metric"><span class="metric-label">Samples received</span><span class="metric-value" id="sampleMetric">0 <small>/ 51</small></span></div>
        <div class="metric"><span class="metric-label">Applied range</span><span class="metric-value" id="rangeMetric">-- <small>V</small></span></div>
        <div class="metric"><span class="metric-label">Last sensed</span><span class="metric-value" id="lastMetric">-- <small>V</small></span></div>
      </section>

      <section class="workspace">
        <section aria-labelledby="plotTitle">
          <div class="section-head"><h2 id="plotTitle">Transfer response</h2><span class="section-note">SENSED VS APPLIED / V</span></div>
          <div class="chart-wrap">
            <canvas id="plot" aria-label="Plot of sensed voltage against applied voltage"></canvas>
            <div class="chart-empty" id="emptyState"><div><span class="empty-mark">+</span><span class="empty-copy">Waiting for voltage pairs</span></div></div>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section aria-labelledby="tableTitle">
          <div class="section-head"><h2 id="tableTitle">Readings</h2><span class="section-note" id="tableCount">0 / 51</span></div>
          <div class="table-wrap">
            <table>
              <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Applied (V)</th><th>Sensed (V)</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody id="readingsBody"><tr><td class="table-empty" colspan="3">No readings yet</td></tr></tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </section>
      </section>
      <footer class="footer"><span>51-point sweep / 0.1 V increments / 0-5 V</span><span>Web Serial / 115200 baud</span></footer>
    </main>
  </div>

  <script>
    (() => {
      const sampleLimit = 51;
      const samples = [];
      const startButton = document.querySelector("#startButton");
      const stopButton = document.querySelector("#stopButton");
      const exportButton = document.querySelector("#exportButton");
      const status = document.querySelector("#status");
      const statusText = document.querySelector("#statusText");
      const connectionDot = document.querySelector("#connectionDot");
      const connectionLabel = document.querySelector("#connectionLabel");
      const canvas = document.querySelector("#plot");
      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      let activeReader = null;
      let stopRequested = false;
      let runCount = 0;
      const themeToggle = document.querySelector("#themeToggle");

      function setTheme(theme) {
        const isDark = theme === "dark";
        document.documentElement.dataset.theme = isDark ? "dark" : "light";
        themeToggle.textContent = isDark ? "Light mode" : "Dark mode";
        themeToggle.setAttribute("aria-label", `Switch to ${isDark ? "light" : "dark"} mode`);
        localStorage.setItem("mosfet-theme", isDark ? "dark" : "light");
        drawPlot();
      }

      function setStatus(message, kind = "") {
        statusText.textContent = message;
        status.dataset.kind = kind;
      }

      function setConnected(connected) {
        connectionDot.classList.toggle("active", connected);
        connectionLabel.textContent = connected ? "SERIAL CONNECTED" : "SERIAL OFFLINE";
      }

      function renderTable() {
        const body = document.querySelector("#readingsBody");
        body.replaceChildren();
        if (!samples.length) {
          const row = body.insertRow();
          const cell = row.insertCell();
          cell.colSpan = 3;
          cell.className = "table-empty";
          cell.textContent = "No readings yet";
        } else {
          samples.forEach((sample, index) => {
            const row = body.insertRow();
            row.insertCell().textContent = String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0");
            row.insertCell().textContent = sample.applied.toFixed(3);
            row.insertCell().textContent = sample.sensed.toFixed(3);
          });
        }
        document.querySelector("#tableCount").textContent = `${samples.length} / ${sampleLimit}`;
        document.querySelector("#sampleMetric").innerHTML = `${samples.length} <small>/ ${sampleLimit}</small>`;
        document.querySelector("#lastMetric").innerHTML = samples.length ? `${samples[samples.length - 1].sensed.toFixed(3)} <small>V</small>` : "-- <small>V</small>";
        document.querySelector("#rangeMetric").innerHTML = samples.length ? `${samples[0].applied.toFixed(1)}-${samples[samples.length - 1].applied.toFixed(1)} <small>V</small>` : "-- <small>V</small>";
        exportButton.disabled = samples.length === 0;
        document.querySelector("#emptyState").hidden = samples.length > 0;
        drawPlot();
      }

      function getAxis(values) {
        const dataMin = Math.min(...values);
        const dataMax = Math.max(...values);
        let min = dataMin;
        let max = dataMax;
        if (min === max) {
          const spread = Math.max(Math.abs(min) * 0.1, 0.1);
          min -= spread / 2;
          max += spread / 2;
        }

        const padding = (max - min) * 0.08;
        const paddedMin = min - padding;
        const paddedMax = max + padding;
        const roughStep = (paddedMax - paddedMin) / 5;
        const magnitude = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(roughStep));
        const fraction = roughStep / magnitude;
        const niceFraction = fraction <= 1 ? 1 : fraction <= 2 ? 2 : fraction <= 5 ? 5 : 10;
        const step = niceFraction * magnitude;
        const axisMin = dataMin >= 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(paddedMin / step) * step) : Math.floor(paddedMin / step) * step;
        const axisMax = Math.ceil(paddedMax / step) * step;

        return { min: axisMin, max: axisMax > axisMin ? axisMax : axisMin + step, step };
      }

      function formatTick(value, step) {
        const decimals = Math.max(0, Math.min(6, -Math.floor(Math.log10(step))));
        return value.toFixed(decimals);
      }

      function drawPlot() {
        const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!bounds.width || !bounds.height) return;
        const ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = Math.round(bounds.width * ratio);
        canvas.height = Math.round(bounds.height * ratio);
        context.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
        context.clearRect(0, 0, bounds.width, bounds.height);

        const pad = { left: 48, right: 14, top: 15, bottom: 36 };
        const width = bounds.width - pad.left - pad.right;
        const height = bounds.height - pad.top - pad.bottom;
        const appliedAxis = getAxis(samples.length ? samples.map(sample => sample.applied) : [0, 5]);
        const sensedAxis = getAxis(samples.length ? samples.map(sample => sample.sensed) : [0, 5]);
        const palette = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
        const chartAxis = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-axis").trim();
        const chartGrid = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-grid").trim();
        const chartLabel = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-label").trim();
        const chartLine = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-line").trim();
        const chartPointFill = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-point-fill").trim();
        context.font = '10px Consolas, monospace';
        context.textAlign = "right";
        context.textBaseline = "middle";
        const sensedTickCount = Math.round((sensedAxis.max - sensedAxis.min) / sensedAxis.step);
        for (let index = 0; index <= sensedTickCount; index += 1) {
          const tick = sensedAxis.min + index * sensedAxis.step;
          const y = pad.top + height - ((tick - sensedAxis.min) / (sensedAxis.max - sensedAxis.min)) * height;
          context.beginPath();
          context.strokeStyle = index === 0 ? chartAxis : chartGrid;
          context.lineWidth = 1;
          context.moveTo(pad.left, y);
          context.lineTo(pad.left + width, y);
          context.stroke();
          context.fillStyle = chartLabel;
          context.fillText(formatTick(tick, sensedAxis.step), pad.left - 10, y);
        }
        context.textAlign = "center";
        const appliedTickCount = Math.round((appliedAxis.max - appliedAxis.min) / appliedAxis.step);
        for (let index = 0; index <= appliedTickCount; index += 1) {
          const tick = appliedAxis.min + index * appliedAxis.step;
          const x = pad.left + ((tick - appliedAxis.min) / (appliedAxis.max - appliedAxis.min)) * width;
          context.beginPath();
          context.strokeStyle = chartGrid;
          context.moveTo(x, pad.top);
          context.lineTo(x, pad.top + height);
          context.stroke();
          context.fillStyle = chartLabel;
          context.fillText(formatTick(tick, appliedAxis.step), x, pad.top + height + 16);
        }
        if (samples.length) {
          const pointX = value => pad.left + ((value - appliedAxis.min) / (appliedAxis.max - appliedAxis.min)) * width;
          const pointY = value => pad.top + height - ((value - sensedAxis.min) / (sensedAxis.max - sensedAxis.min)) * height;
          context.beginPath();
          samples.forEach((sample, index) => {
            const x = pointX(sample.applied);
            const y = pointY(sample.sensed);
            if (index === 0) context.moveTo(x, y);
            else context.lineTo(x, y);
          });
          context.strokeStyle = chartLine;
          context.lineWidth = 2;
          context.stroke();
          samples.forEach(sample => {
            context.beginPath();
            context.arc(pointX(sample.applied), pointY(sample.sensed), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            context.fillStyle = chartPointFill;
            context.fill();
            context.strokeStyle = chartLine;
            context.lineWidth = 1.5;
            context.stroke();
          });
        }
      }

      function addLine(line) {
        const values = line.trim().split(",");
        if (values.length !== 2) return;
        const applied = Number(values[0]);
        const sensed = Number(values[1]);
        if (!Number.isFinite(applied) || !Number.isFinite(sensed)) return;
        samples.push({ applied, sensed });
        renderTable();
        setStatus(`Receiving sample ${String(samples.length).padStart(2, "0")} of ${sampleLimit}...`);
      }

      function readWithTimeout(reader, milliseconds) {
        let timeoutId;
        return Promise.race([
          reader.read(),
          new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("No serial data received for 10 seconds.")), milliseconds);
          })
        ]).finally(() => window.clearTimeout(timeoutId));
      }

      async function capture() {
        if (!("serial" in navigator)) {
          setStatus("Web Serial is unavailable. Open this page in Chrome or Edge.", "error");
          return;
        }
        samples.length = 0;
        renderTable();
        stopRequested = false;
        runCount += 1;
        document.querySelector("#runNumber").textContent = String(runCount).padStart(3, "0");
        startButton.disabled = true;
        stopButton.disabled = false;
        setStatus("Choose the Arduino serial port...");
        let port;
        let reader;
        try {
          port = await navigator.serial.requestPort();
          await port.open({ baudRate: 115200 });
          setConnected(true);
          setStatus("Listening for voltage pairs...");
          const decoder = new TextDecoderStream();
          const decoderClosed = port.readable.pipeTo(decoder.writable).catch(() => {});
          reader = decoder.readable.getReader();
          activeReader = reader;
          let remainder = "";
          while (samples.length < sampleLimit) {
            const { value, done } = await readWithTimeout(reader, 10000);
            if (done) break;
            remainder += value;
            const lines = remainder.split(/\r?\n/);
            remainder = lines.pop();
            for (const line of lines) {
              addLine(line);
              if (samples.length === sampleLimit) break;
            }
          }
          if (samples.length === sampleLimit) setStatus("Capture complete: 51 voltage pairs received.", "success");
          else if (stopRequested) setStatus(`Capture stopped at ${samples.length} samples.`);
          else setStatus("Serial stream ended before 51 samples.", "error");
        } catch (error) {
          if (error.name === "NotFoundError") setStatus("No port selected.");
          else if (error.name === "AbortError" && stopRequested) setStatus(`Capture stopped at ${samples.length} samples.`);
          else setStatus(error.message || "Serial capture failed.", "error");
        } finally {
          activeReader = null;
          if (reader) {
            try { await reader.cancel(); } catch {}
            reader.releaseLock();
          }
          if (port?.readable) {
            try { await port.close(); } catch {}
          }
          setConnected(false);
          startButton.disabled = false;
          stopButton.disabled = true;
        }
      }

      startButton.addEventListener("click", capture);
      themeToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
        setTheme(document.documentElement.dataset.theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark");
      });
      stopButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (activeReader) {
          stopRequested = true;
          setStatus("Stopping capture...");
          activeReader.cancel();
        }
      });
      exportButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const csv = ["applied_voltage,sensed_voltage", ...samples.map(sample => `${sample.applied.toFixed(3)},${sample.sensed.toFixed(3)}`)].join("\n");
        const link = document.createElement("a");
        link.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" }));
        link.download = "mosfet-voltage-sweep.csv";
        link.click();
        window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href), 1000);
      });
      new ResizeObserver(drawPlot).observe(canvas);
      setTheme(localStorage.getItem("mosfet-theme") === "dark" ? "dark" : "light");
      renderTable();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```
        </section>
        <section aria-labelledby="tableTitle">
          <div class="section-head"><h2 id="tableTitle">Readings</h2><span class="section-note" id="tableCount">0 / 51</span></div>
          <div class="table-wrap">
            <table>
              <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Applied (V)</th><th>Sensed (V)</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody id="readingsBody"><tr><td class="table-empty" colspan="3">No readings yet</td></tr></tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </section>
      </section>
      <footer class="footer"><span>51-point sweep / 0.1 V increments / 0-5 V</span><span>Web Serial / 115200 baud</span></footer>
    </main>
  </div>

  <script>
    (() => {
      const sampleLimit = 51;
      const samples = [];
      const startButton = document.querySelector("#startButton");
      const stopButton = document.querySelector("#stopButton");
      const exportButton = document.querySelector("#exportButton");
      const status = document.querySelector("#status");
      const statusText = document.querySelector("#statusText");
      const connectionDot = document.querySelector("#connectionDot");
      const connectionLabel = document.querySelector("#connectionLabel");
      const canvas = document.querySelector("#plot");
      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      let activeReader = null;
      let stopRequested = false;
      let runCount = 0;
      const themeToggle = document.querySelector("#themeToggle");

      function setTheme(theme) {
        const isDark = theme === "dark";
        document.documentElement.dataset.theme = isDark ? "dark" : "light";
        themeToggle.textContent = isDark ? "Light mode" : "Dark mode";
        themeToggle.setAttribute("aria-label", `Switch to ${isDark ? "light" : "dark"} mode`);
        localStorage.setItem("mosfet-theme", isDark ? "dark" : "light");
        drawPlot();
      }

      function setStatus(message, kind = "") {
        statusText.textContent = message;
        status.dataset.kind = kind;
      }

      function setConnected(connected) {
        connectionDot.classList.toggle("active", connected);
        connectionLabel.textContent = connected ? "SERIAL CONNECTED" : "SERIAL OFFLINE";
      }

      function renderTable() {
        const body = document.querySelector("#readingsBody");
        body.replaceChildren();
        if (!samples.length) {
          const row = body.insertRow();
          const cell = row.insertCell();
          cell.colSpan = 3;
          cell.className = "table-empty";
          cell.textContent = "No readings yet";
        } else {
          samples.forEach((sample, index) => {
            const row = body.insertRow();
            row.insertCell().textContent = String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0");
            row.insertCell().textContent = sample.applied.toFixed(3);
            row.insertCell().textContent = sample.sensed.toFixed(3);
          });
        }
        document.querySelector("#tableCount").textContent = `${samples.length} / ${sampleLimit}`;
        document.querySelector("#sampleMetric").innerHTML = `${samples.length} <small>/ ${sampleLimit}</small>`;
        document.querySelector("#lastMetric").innerHTML = samples.length ? `${samples[samples.length - 1].sensed.toFixed(3)} <small>V</small>` : "-- <small>V</small>";
        document.querySelector("#rangeMetric").innerHTML = samples.length ? `${samples[0].applied.toFixed(1)}-${samples[samples.length - 1].applied.toFixed(1)} <small>V</small>` : "-- <small>V</small>";
        exportButton.disabled = samples.length === 0;
        drawPlot();
      }

      function getAxis(values) {
        const dataMin = Math.min(...values);
        const dataMax = Math.max(...values);
        let min = dataMin;
        let max = dataMax;
        if (min === max) {
          const spread = Math.max(Math.abs(min) * 0.1, 0.1);
          min -= spread / 2;
          max += spread / 2;
        }

        const padding = (max - min) * 0.08;
        const paddedMin = min - padding;
        const paddedMax = max + padding;
        const roughStep = (paddedMax - paddedMin) / 5;
        const magnitude = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(roughStep));
        const fraction = roughStep / magnitude;
        const niceFraction = fraction <= 1 ? 1 : fraction <= 2 ? 2 : fraction <= 5 ? 5 : 10;
        const step = niceFraction * magnitude;
        const axisMin = dataMin >= 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(paddedMin / step) * step) : Math.floor(paddedMin / step) * step;
        const axisMax = Math.ceil(paddedMax / step) * step;

        return { min: axisMin, max: axisMax > axisMin ? axisMax : axisMin + step, step };
      }

      function formatTick(value, step) {
        const decimals = Math.max(0, Math.min(6, -Math.floor(Math.log10(step))));
        return value.toFixed(decimals);
      }

      function drawPlot() {
        const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!bounds.width || !bounds.height) return;
        const ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = Math.round(bounds.width * ratio);
        canvas.height = Math.round(bounds.height * ratio);
        context.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
        context.clearRect(0, 0, bounds.width, bounds.height);

        const pad = { left: 48, right: 14, top: 15, bottom: 36 };
        const width = bounds.width - pad.left - pad.right;
        const height = bounds.height - pad.top - pad.bottom;
        const appliedAxis = getAxis(samples.length ? samples.map(sample => sample.applied) : [0, 5]);
        const sensedAxis = getAxis(samples.length ? samples.map(sample => sample.sensed) : [0, 5]);
        const palette = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
        const chartAxis = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-axis").trim();
        const chartGrid = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-grid").trim();
        const chartLabel = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-label").trim();
        const chartLine = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-line").trim();
        const chartPointFill = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-point-fill").trim();
        context.font = '10px Consolas, monospace';
        context.textAlign = "right";
        context.textBaseline = "middle";
        const sensedTickCount = Math.round((sensedAxis.max - sensedAxis.min) / sensedAxis.step);
        for (let index = 0; index <= sensedTickCount; index += 1) {
          const tick = sensedAxis.min + index * sensedAxis.step;
          const y = pad.top + height - ((tick - sensedAxis.min) / (sensedAxis.max - sensedAxis.min)) * height;
          context.beginPath();
          context.strokeStyle = index === 0 ? chartAxis : chartGrid;
          context.lineWidth = 1;
          context.moveTo(pad.left, y);
          context.lineTo(pad.left + width, y);
          context.stroke();
          context.fillStyle = chartLabel;
          context.fillText(formatTick(tick, sensedAxis.step), pad.left - 10, y);
        }
        context.textAlign = "center";
        const appliedTickCount = Math.round((appliedAxis.max - appliedAxis.min) / appliedAxis.step);
        for (let index = 0; index <= appliedTickCount; index += 1) {
          const tick = appliedAxis.min + index * appliedAxis.step;
          const x = pad.left + ((tick - appliedAxis.min) / (appliedAxis.max - appliedAxis.min)) * width;
          context.beginPath();
          context.strokeStyle = chartGrid;
          context.moveTo(x, pad.top);
          context.lineTo(x, pad.top + height);
          context.stroke();
          context.fillStyle = chartLabel;
          context.fillText(formatTick(tick, appliedAxis.step), x, pad.top + height + 16);
        }
        if (samples.length) {
          const pointX = value => pad.left + ((value - appliedAxis.min) / (appliedAxis.max - appliedAxis.min)) * width;
          const pointY = value => pad.top + height - ((value - sensedAxis.min) / (sensedAxis.max - sensedAxis.min)) * height;
          context.beginPath();
          samples.forEach((sample, index) => {
            const x = pointX(sample.applied);
            const y = pointY(sample.sensed);
            if (index === 0) context.moveTo(x, y);
            else context.lineTo(x, y);
          });
          context.strokeStyle = chartLine;
          context.lineWidth = 2;
          context.stroke();
          samples.forEach(sample => {
            context.beginPath();
            context.arc(pointX(sample.applied), pointY(sample.sensed), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            context.fillStyle = chartPointFill;
            context.fill();
            context.strokeStyle = chartLine;
            context.lineWidth = 1.5;
            context.stroke();
          });
        }
      }

      function addLine(line) {
        const values = line.trim().split(",");
        if (values.length !== 2) return;
        const applied = Number(values[0]);
        const sensed = Number(values[1]);
        if (!Number.isFinite(applied) || !Number.isFinite(sensed)) return;
        samples.push({ applied, sensed });
        renderTable();
        setStatus(`Receiving sample ${String(samples.length).padStart(2, "0")} of ${sampleLimit}...`);
      }

      function readWithTimeout(reader, milliseconds) {
        let timeoutId;
        return Promise.race([
          reader.read(),
          new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("No serial data received for 10 seconds.")), milliseconds);
          })
        ]).finally(() => window.clearTimeout(timeoutId));
      }

      async function capture() {
        if (!("serial" in navigator)) {
          setStatus("Web Serial is unavailable. Open this page in Chrome or Edge.", "error");
          return;
        }
        samples.length = 0;
        renderTable();
        stopRequested = false;
        runCount += 1;
        document.querySelector("#runNumber").textContent = String(runCount).padStart(3, "0");
        startButton.disabled = true;
        stopButton.disabled = false;
        setStatus("Choose the Arduino serial port...");
        let port;
        let reader;
        try {
          port = await navigator.serial.requestPort();
          await port.open({ baudRate: 115200 });
          setConnected(true);
          setStatus("Listening for voltage pairs...");
          const decoder = new TextDecoderStream();
          const decoderClosed = port.readable.pipeTo(decoder.writable).catch(() => {});
          reader = decoder.readable.getReader();
          activeReader = reader;
          let remainder = "";
          while (samples.length < sampleLimit) {
            const { value, done } = await readWithTimeout(reader, 10000);
            if (done) break;
            remainder += value;
            const lines = remainder.split(/\r?\n/);
            remainder = lines.pop();
            for (const line of lines) {
              addLine(line);
              if (samples.length === sampleLimit) break;
            }
          }
          if (samples.length === sampleLimit) setStatus("Capture complete: 51 voltage pairs received.", "success");
          else if (stopRequested) setStatus(`Capture stopped at ${samples.length} samples.`);
          else setStatus("Serial stream ended before 51 samples.", "error");
        } catch (error) {
          if (error.name === "NotFoundError") setStatus("No port selected.");
          else if (error.name === "AbortError" && stopRequested) setStatus(`Capture stopped at ${samples.length} samples.`);
          else setStatus(error.message || "Serial capture failed.", "error");
        } finally {
          activeReader = null;
          if (reader) {
            try { await reader.cancel(); } catch {}
            reader.releaseLock();
          }
          if (port?.readable) {
            try { await port.close(); } catch {}
          }
          setConnected(false);
          startButton.disabled = false;
          stopButton.disabled = true;
        }
      }

      startButton.addEventListener("click", capture);
      themeToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
        setTheme(document.documentElement.dataset.theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark");
      });
      stopButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (activeReader) {
          stopRequested = true;
          setStatus("Stopping capture...");
          activeReader.cancel();
        }
      });
      exportButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const csv = ["applied_voltage,sensed_voltage", ...samples.map(sample => `${sample.applied.toFixed(3)},${sample.sensed.toFixed(3)}`)].join("\n");
        const link = document.createElement("a");
        link.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" }));
        link.download = "mosfet-voltage-sweep.csv";
        link.click();
        window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href), 1000);
      });
      new ResizeObserver(drawPlot).observe(canvas);
      setTheme(localStorage.getItem("mosfet-theme") === "dark" ? "dark" : "light");
      renderTable();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```
#include <Arduino.h>

const int analogReadPin = A1;

void setup() {
  // Initialize serial communication and wait up to 2.5 seconds for a connection
  Serial.begin(115200);
  for (auto startNow = millis() + 2500; !Serial && millis() < startNow; delay(500));
  
  analogWriteResolution(12);  // set DAC resolution to 12-bit
  analogReadResolution(14); // set analog read resolution to 14 bit
}

void loop() {
  // write
  float writeBit[51] = {}; // 51 steps from 0 V to 5 V, 0.1 V increments
  float writeVoltage[51] = {};

  // read
  float readVoltage[51] = {};
  
  for (int i = 0; i <= 50; i++) {
    writeVoltage[i] = (0.1 * i);
    writeBit[i] = (writeVoltage[i] * 4095) / 5.121; // mapping the voltage to a specific bit in the dac
    analogWrite(DAC, writeBit[i]);

    delay(10); // delay between writing and reading. giving time for the voltage to settle

    int readBit = analogRead(analogReadPin);
    readVoltage[i] = readBit * (5.121 / 16383.0); // mapping the bit read to a corresponding voltage
    
    // print the applied and sensed voltages in the format "applied_voltage,sensed_voltage"
    Serial.print(writeVoltage[i], 3);
    Serial.print(",");
    Serial.print(readVoltage[i], 3);
    Serial.println();

    delay(500); // delay between next iteration
  }
}

// create function for writing and reading voltage
```

```
    .top-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; }
    .theme-toggle { padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px; }
    .theme-toggle:hover { background: var(--hover-surface); }
    .live-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #9ba5a1; }
    .live-dot.active { background: var(--green-bright); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(40, 164, 122, .13); }

    main { padding: 44px 0 52px; }
    .heading-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: end; gap: 24px; margin-bottom: 27px; }
    .eyebrow { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--green); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .11em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    h1 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 44px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: 0; }
    .subtitle { margin: 10px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; }
    .run-index { padding-bottom: 4px; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; }
    .controlbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .primary, .secondary {
      min-height: 40px;
      padding: 0 15px;
      border: 1px solid var(--green);
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 650;
      transition: background .15s, color .15s, border-color .15s;
    }
    .primary { background: var(--green); color: var(--button-text); }
    .primary:hover { background: #105943; }
    .secondary { border-color: var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); }
    .secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #899690; background: var(--hover-surface); }
    button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .42; }
    .serial-config { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-left: 10px; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; }
    .serial-config strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }
    .status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-left: auto; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
    .status[data-kind="error"] { color: var(--red); }
    .status[data-kind="success"] { color: var(--green); }
    .status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

    .metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); margin: 28px 0 34px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .metric { min-height: 83px; padding: 15px 22px 14px 0; }
    .metric + .metric { padding-left: 23px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .metric-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .metric-value { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; }
    .metric-value small { margin-left: 4px; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; }

    .workspace { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 310px; gap: 35px; align-items: start; }
    .section-head { min-height: 39px; display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
    h2 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 21px; font-weight: 500; }
    .section-note { color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; }
    .chart-wrap { position: relative; height: 390px; padding-top: 14px; }
    canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
    .table-wrap { max-height: 440px; overflow: auto; scrollbar-color: #bdc7c1 transparent; scrollbar-width: thin; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; }
    th { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; padding: 11px 8px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .04em; text-align: right; text-transform: uppercase; }
    th:first-child, td:first-child { width: 46px; text-align: left; }
    td { padding: 8px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(217, 223, 219, .75); text-align: right; }
    tbody tr:first-child td { border-top-color: var(--line); }
    td:first-child { color: var(--muted); }
    .table-empty { padding: 18px 8px; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; }
    .footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-top: 23px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; }

    @media (max-width: 850px) {
      .shell { padding: 0 25px; }
      .workspace { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 260px; gap: 23px; }
      .chart-wrap { height: 340px; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 650px) {
      .shell { padding: 0 18px; }
      main { padding-top: 32px; }
      .heading-row { align-items: start; }
      .run-index { padding-top: 5px; }
      .controlbar { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 9px; }
      .serial-config { margin-left: 4px; }
      .status { flex-basis: 100%; margin: 4px 0 0; }
      .metrics { margin: 20px 0 28px; }
      .metric { min-height: 73px; padding-right: 9px; }
      .metric + .metric { padding-left: 12px; }
      .metric-value { font-size: 23px; }
      .workspace { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 27px; }
      .chart-wrap { height: 300px; }
      .table-wrap { max-height: 260px; }
      .footer { flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 390px) {
      .top-actions { gap: 8px; }
      .top-meta { font-size: 9px; }
      .theme-toggle { padding: 6px 7px; font-size: 10px; }
      .wordmark { font-size: 10px; }
      .serial-config { font-size: 10px; }
      .metric-label { font-size: 8px; }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { scroll-behavior: auto !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; } }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="shell">
    <header class="topbar">
      <div class="wordmark"><span class="mark" aria-hidden="true">M</span> Materials Lab <span class="wordmark-separator" aria-hidden="true">/</span> Device Characterization</div>
      <div class="top-actions">
        <button class="theme-toggle" id="themeToggle" type="button" aria-label="Switch to dark mode">Dark mode</button>
        <div class="top-meta"><span class="live-dot" id="connectionDot"></span><span id="connectionLabel">SERIAL OFFLINE</span></div>
      </div>
    </header>

    <main>
      <section class="heading-row" aria-labelledby="pageTitle">
        <div>
          <p class="eyebrow">Bench console <span aria-hidden="true">/</span> MOSFET study</p>
          <h1 id="pageTitle">Voltage sweep</h1>
          <p class="subtitle">Applied and sensed voltage characterization</p>
        </div>
        <div class="run-index">RUN <span id="runNumber">--</span></div>
      </section>

      <section class="controlbar" aria-label="Serial controls">
        <button class="primary" id="startButton" type="button">Connect &amp; capture</button>
        <button class="secondary" id="stopButton" type="button" disabled>Stop</button>
        <button class="secondary" id="exportButton" type="button" disabled>Export CSV</button>
        <div class="serial-config"><span>PORT</span><strong>USB serial</strong><span aria-hidden="true">/</span><span>BAUD</span><strong>115200</strong></div>
        <div class="status" id="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"><span class="status-dot"></span><span id="statusText">Select the Arduino to begin.</span></div>
      </section>

      <section class="metrics" aria-label="Capture summary">
        <div class="metric"><span class="metric-label">Samples received</span><span class="metric-value" id="sampleMetric">0 <small>readings</small></span></div>
        <div class="metric"><span class="metric-label">Applied range</span><span class="metric-value" id="rangeMetric">-- <small>V</small></span></div>
        <div class="metric"><span class="metric-label">Last sensed</span><span class="metric-value" id="lastMetric">-- <small>V</small></span></div>
      </section>

      <section class="workspace">
        <section aria-labelledby="plotTitle">
          <div class="section-head"><h2 id="plotTitle">Transfer response</h2><span class="section-note">SENSED VS APPLIED / V</span></div>
          <div class="chart-wrap">
            <canvas id="plot" aria-label="Plot of sensed voltage against applied voltage"></canvas>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section aria-labelledby="tableTitle">
          <div class="section-head"><h2 id="tableTitle">Latest readings</h2><span class="section-note" id="tableCount">0 total</span></div>
          <div class="table-wrap">
            <table>
              <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Applied (V)</th><th>Sensed (V)</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody id="readingsBody"><tr><td class="table-empty" colspan="3">No readings yet</td></tr></tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </section>
      </section>
      <footer class="footer"><span>Continuous capture / recurring 51-point sweeps / 0.1 V increments</span><span>Web Serial / 115200 baud</span></footer>
    </main>
  </div>

  <script>
    (() => {
      const tableRowLimit = 500;
      const chartPointLimit = 2000;
      const samples = [];
      const startButton = document.querySelector("#startButton");
      const stopButton = document.querySelector("#stopButton");
      const exportButton = document.querySelector("#exportButton");
      const status = document.querySelector("#status");
      const statusText = document.querySelector("#statusText");
      const connectionDot = document.querySelector("#connectionDot");
      const connectionLabel = document.querySelector("#connectionLabel");
      const canvas = document.querySelector("#plot");
      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      let activeReader = null;
      let stopRequested = false;
      let runCount = 0;
      let appliedMin = Infinity;
      let appliedMax = -Infinity;
      let sensedMin = Infinity;
      let sensedMax = -Infinity;
      let appliedMinIndex = -1;
      let appliedMaxIndex = -1;
      let sensedMinIndex = -1;
      let sensedMaxIndex = -1;
      const themeToggle = document.querySelector("#themeToggle");

      function setTheme(theme) {
        const isDark = theme === "dark";
        document.documentElement.dataset.theme = isDark ? "dark" : "light";
        themeToggle.textContent = isDark ? "Light mode" : "Dark mode";
        themeToggle.setAttribute("aria-label", `Switch to ${isDark ? "light" : "dark"} mode`);
        localStorage.setItem("mosfet-theme", isDark ? "dark" : "light");
        drawPlot();
      }

      function setStatus(message, kind = "") {
        statusText.textContent = message;
        status.dataset.kind = kind;
      }

      function setConnected(connected) {
        connectionDot.classList.toggle("active", connected);
        connectionLabel.textContent = connected ? "SERIAL CONNECTED" : "SERIAL OFFLINE";
      }

      function renderTable() {
        const body = document.querySelector("#readingsBody");
        body.replaceChildren();
        if (!samples.length) {
          const row = body.insertRow();
          const cell = row.insertCell();
          cell.colSpan = 3;
          cell.className = "table-empty";
          cell.textContent = "No readings yet";
        } else {
          const firstVisibleIndex = Math.max(0, samples.length - tableRowLimit);
          for (let index = firstVisibleIndex; index < samples.length; index += 1) appendReadingRow(body, index);
        }
        updateReadout();
        drawPlot();
      }

      function appendReadingRow(body, index) {
        if (index === 0) body.replaceChildren();
        const sample = samples[index];
        const row = body.insertRow();
        row.insertCell().textContent = String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0");
        row.insertCell().textContent = sample.applied.toFixed(3);
        row.insertCell().textContent = sample.sensed.toFixed(3);
        if (body.rows.length > tableRowLimit) body.deleteRow(0);
      }

      function updateReadout() {
        document.querySelector("#tableCount").textContent = `${samples.length.toLocaleString()} total`;
        document.querySelector("#sampleMetric").innerHTML = `${samples.length.toLocaleString()} <small>readings</small>`;
        document.querySelector("#lastMetric").innerHTML = samples.length ? `${samples[samples.length - 1].sensed.toFixed(3)} <small>V</small>` : "-- <small>V</small>";
        document.querySelector("#rangeMetric").innerHTML = samples.length ? `${samples[0].applied.toFixed(1)}-${samples[samples.length - 1].applied.toFixed(1)} <small>V</small>` : "-- <small>V</small>";
        exportButton.disabled = samples.length === 0;
      }

      function getAxis(dataMin, dataMax) {
        let min = dataMin;
        let max = dataMax;
        if (min === max) {
          const spread = Math.max(Math.abs(min) * 0.1, 0.1);
          min -= spread / 2;
          max += spread / 2;
        }

        const padding = (max - min) * 0.08;
        const paddedMin = min - padding;
        const paddedMax = max + padding;
        const roughStep = (paddedMax - paddedMin) / 5;
        const magnitude = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(roughStep));
        const fraction = roughStep / magnitude;
        const niceFraction = fraction <= 1 ? 1 : fraction <= 2 ? 2 : fraction <= 5 ? 5 : 10;
        const step = niceFraction * magnitude;
        const axisMin = dataMin >= 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(paddedMin / step) * step) : Math.floor(paddedMin / step) * step;
        const axisMax = Math.ceil(paddedMax / step) * step;

        return { min: axisMin, max: axisMax > axisMin ? axisMax : axisMin + step, step };
      }

      function getPlottedSamples() {
        if (samples.length <= chartPointLimit) return samples;
        const lastIndex = samples.length - 1;
        const indices = new Set([0, lastIndex, appliedMinIndex, appliedMaxIndex, sensedMinIndex, sensedMaxIndex]);
        for (let point = 0; point < chartPointLimit; point += 1) {
          indices.add(Math.round(point * lastIndex / (chartPointLimit - 1)));
        }
        return Array.from(indices).sort((left, right) => left - right).map(index => samples[index]);
      }

      function formatTick(value, step) {
        const decimals = Math.max(0, Math.min(6, -Math.floor(Math.log10(step))));
        return value.toFixed(decimals);
      }

      function drawPlot() {
        const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!bounds.width || !bounds.height) return;
        const ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = Math.round(bounds.width * ratio);
        canvas.height = Math.round(bounds.height * ratio);
        context.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
        context.clearRect(0, 0, bounds.width, bounds.height);

        const pad = { left: 48, right: 14, top: 15, bottom: 36 };
        const width = bounds.width - pad.left - pad.right;
        const height = bounds.height - pad.top - pad.bottom;
        const appliedAxis = samples.length ? getAxis(appliedMin, appliedMax) : getAxis(0, 5);
        const sensedAxis = samples.length ? getAxis(sensedMin, sensedMax) : getAxis(0, 5);
        const plottedSamples = getPlottedSamples();
        const palette = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
        const chartAxis = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-axis").trim();
        const chartGrid = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-grid").trim();
        const chartLabel = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-label").trim();
        const chartLine = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-line").trim();
        const chartPointFill = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-point-fill").trim();
        context.font = '10px Consolas, monospace';
        context.textAlign = "right";
        context.textBaseline = "middle";
        const sensedTickCount = Math.round((sensedAxis.max - sensedAxis.min) / sensedAxis.step);
        for (let index = 0; index <= sensedTickCount; index += 1) {
          const tick = sensedAxis.min + index * sensedAxis.step;
          const y = pad.top + height - ((tick - sensedAxis.min) / (sensedAxis.max - sensedAxis.min)) * height;
          context.beginPath();
          context.strokeStyle = index === 0 ? chartAxis : chartGrid;
          context.lineWidth = 1;
          context.moveTo(pad.left, y);
          context.lineTo(pad.left + width, y);
          context.stroke();
          context.fillStyle = chartLabel;
          context.fillText(formatTick(tick, sensedAxis.step), pad.left - 10, y);
        }
        context.textAlign = "center";
        const appliedTickCount = Math.round((appliedAxis.max - appliedAxis.min) / appliedAxis.step);
        for (let index = 0; index <= appliedTickCount; index += 1) {
          const tick = appliedAxis.min + index * appliedAxis.step;
          const x = pad.left + ((tick - appliedAxis.min) / (appliedAxis.max - appliedAxis.min)) * width;
          context.beginPath();
          context.strokeStyle = chartGrid;
          context.moveTo(x, pad.top);
          context.lineTo(x, pad.top + height);
          context.stroke();
          context.fillStyle = chartLabel;
          context.fillText(formatTick(tick, appliedAxis.step), x, pad.top + height + 16);
        }
        if (samples.length) {
          const pointX = value => pad.left + ((value - appliedAxis.min) / (appliedAxis.max - appliedAxis.min)) * width;
          const pointY = value => pad.top + height - ((value - sensedAxis.min) / (sensedAxis.max - sensedAxis.min)) * height;
          context.beginPath();
          plottedSamples.forEach((sample, index) => {
            const x = pointX(sample.applied);
            const y = pointY(sample.sensed);
            if (index === 0) context.moveTo(x, y);
            else context.lineTo(x, y);
          });
          context.strokeStyle = chartLine;
          context.lineWidth = 2;
          context.stroke();
          plottedSamples.forEach(sample => {
            context.beginPath();
            context.arc(pointX(sample.applied), pointY(sample.sensed), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            context.fillStyle = chartPointFill;
            context.fill();
            context.strokeStyle = chartLine;
            context.lineWidth = 1.5;
            context.stroke();
          });
        }
      }

      function addLine(line) {
        const values = line.trim().split(",");
        if (values.length !== 2) return;
        const applied = Number(values[0]);
        const sensed = Number(values[1]);
        if (!Number.isFinite(applied) || !Number.isFinite(sensed)) return;
        const index = samples.length;
        samples.push({ applied, sensed });
        if (applied < appliedMin) { appliedMin = applied; appliedMinIndex = index; }
        if (applied > appliedMax) { appliedMax = applied; appliedMaxIndex = index; }
        if (sensed < sensedMin) { sensedMin = sensed; sensedMinIndex = index; }
        if (sensed > sensedMax) { sensedMax = sensed; sensedMaxIndex = index; }
        appendReadingRow(document.querySelector("#readingsBody"), index);
        updateReadout();
        drawPlot();
        setStatus(`Receiving sample ${samples.length.toLocaleString()}...`);
      }

      function readWithTimeout(reader, milliseconds) {
        let timeoutId;
        return Promise.race([
          reader.read(),
          new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("No serial data received for 10 seconds.")), milliseconds);
          })
        ]).finally(() => window.clearTimeout(timeoutId));
      }

      async function capture() {
        if (!("serial" in navigator)) {
          setStatus("Web Serial is unavailable. Open this page in Chrome or Edge.", "error");
          return;
        }
        samples.length = 0;
        appliedMin = Infinity;
        appliedMax = -Infinity;
        sensedMin = Infinity;
        sensedMax = -Infinity;
        appliedMinIndex = -1;
        appliedMaxIndex = -1;
        sensedMinIndex = -1;
        sensedMaxIndex = -1;
        renderTable();
        stopRequested = false;
        runCount += 1;
        document.querySelector("#runNumber").textContent = String(runCount).padStart(3, "0");
        startButton.disabled = true;
        stopButton.disabled = false;
        setStatus("Choose the Arduino serial port...");
        let port;
        let reader;
        try {
          port = await navigator.serial.requestPort();
          await port.open({ baudRate: 115200 });
          setConnected(true);
          setStatus("Listening for voltage pairs...");
          const decoder = new TextDecoderStream();
          const decoderClosed = port.readable.pipeTo(decoder.writable).catch(() => {});
          reader = decoder.readable.getReader();
          activeReader = reader;
          let remainder = "";
          while (!stopRequested) {
            const { value, done } = await readWithTimeout(reader, 10000);
            if (done) break;
            remainder += value;
            const lines = remainder.split(/\r?\n/);
            remainder = lines.pop();
            for (const line of lines) {
              addLine(line);
            }
          }
          if (stopRequested) setStatus(`Capture stopped at ${samples.length.toLocaleString()} readings.`);
          else setStatus(`Serial stream ended after ${samples.length.toLocaleString()} readings.`, "error");
        } catch (error) {
          if (error.name === "NotFoundError") setStatus("No port selected.");
          else if (error.name === "AbortError" && stopRequested) setStatus(`Capture stopped at ${samples.length.toLocaleString()} readings.`);
          else setStatus(error.message || "Serial capture failed.", "error");
        } finally {
          activeReader = null;
          if (reader) {
            try { await reader.cancel(); } catch {}
            reader.releaseLock();
          }
          if (port?.readable) {
            try { await port.close(); } catch {}
          }
          setConnected(false);
          startButton.disabled = false;
          stopButton.disabled = true;
        }
      }

      startButton.addEventListener("click", capture);
      themeToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
        setTheme(document.documentElement.dataset.theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark");
      });
      stopButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (activeReader) {
          stopRequested = true;
          setStatus("Stopping capture...");
          activeReader.cancel();
        }
      });
      exportButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const csv = ["applied_voltage,sensed_voltage", ...samples.map(sample => `${sample.applied.toFixed(3)},${sample.sensed.toFixed(3)}`)].join("\n");
        const link = document.createElement("a");
        link.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" }));
        link.download = "mosfet-voltage-sweep.csv";
        link.click();
        window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href), 1000);
      });
      new ResizeObserver(drawPlot).observe(canvas);
      setTheme(localStorage.getItem("mosfet-theme") === "dark" ? "dark" : "light");
      renderTable();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```
          const spread = Math.max(Math.abs(min) * 0.1, 0.1);
```

```
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { scroll-behavior: auto !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; } }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="shell">
    <header class="topbar">
      <div class="wordmark"><span class="mark" aria-hidden="true">M</span> Materials Lab <span class="wordmark-separator" aria-hidden="true">/</span> Device Characterization</div>
      <div class="top-actions">
        <button class="theme-toggle" id="themeToggle" type="button" aria-label="Switch to dark mode">Dark mode</button>
        <div class="top-meta"><span class="live-dot" id="connectionDot"></span><span id="connectionLabel">SERIAL OFFLINE</span></div>
      </div>
    </header>

    <main>
      <section class="heading-row" aria-labelledby="pageTitle">
        <div>
          <p class="eyebrow">Bench console <span aria-hidden="true">/</span> MOSFET study</p>
          <h1 id="pageTitle">Voltage sweep</h1>
          <p class="subtitle">Applied and sensed voltage characterization</p>
        </div>
        <div class="run-index">RUN <span id="runNumber">--</span></div>
      </section>

      <section class="controlbar" aria-label="Serial controls">
        <button class="primary" id="startButton" type="button">Connect &amp; capture</button>
        <button class="secondary" id="stopButton" type="button" disabled>Stop</button>
        <button class="secondary" id="exportButton" type="button" disabled>Export CSV</button>
        <div class="serial-config"><span>PORT</span><strong>USB serial</strong><span aria-hidden="true">/</span><span>BAUD</span><strong>115200</strong></div>
        <div class="status" id="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"><span class="status-dot"></span><span id="statusText">Select the Arduino to begin.</span></div>
      </section>

      <section class="metrics" aria-label="Capture summary">
        <div class="metric"><span class="metric-label">Samples received</span><span class="metric-value" id="sampleMetric">0 <small>readings</small></span></div>
        <div class="metric"><span class="metric-label">Applied range</span><span class="metric-value" id="rangeMetric">-- <small>V</small></span></div>
        <div class="metric"><span class="metric-label">Last sensed</span><span class="metric-value" id="lastMetric">-- <small>V</small></span></div>
      </section>

      <section class="workspace">
        <section aria-labelledby="plotTitle">
          <div class="section-head"><h2 id="plotTitle">Transfer response</h2><span class="section-note">SENSED VS APPLIED / V</span></div>
          <div class="chart-wrap">
            <canvas id="plot" aria-label="Plot of sensed voltage against applied voltage. Horizontal axis: applied voltage. Vertical axis: sensed voltage."></canvas>
            <div class="chart-tooltip" id="chartTooltip" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></div>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section aria-labelledby="tableTitle">
          <div class="section-head"><h2 id="tableTitle">Latest readings</h2><span class="section-note" id="tableCount">0 total</span></div>
          <div class="table-wrap">
            <table>
              <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Applied (V)</th><th>Sensed (V)</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody id="readingsBody"><tr><td class="table-empty" colspan="3">No readings yet</td></tr></tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </section>
      </section>
      <footer class="footer"><span>Continuous capture / recurring 51-point sweeps / 0.1 V increments</span><span>Web Serial / 115200 baud</span></footer>
    </main>
  </div>

  <script>
    (() => {
      const tableRowLimit = 500;
      const chartPointLimit = 2000;
      const plotPadding = { left: 54, right: 14, top: 15, bottom: 50 };
      const samples = [];
      const startButton = document.querySelector("#startButton");
      const stopButton = document.querySelector("#stopButton");
      const exportButton = document.querySelector("#exportButton");
      const status = document.querySelector("#status");
      const statusText = document.querySelector("#statusText");
      const connectionDot = document.querySelector("#connectionDot");
      const connectionLabel = document.querySelector("#connectionLabel");
      const canvas = document.querySelector("#plot");
      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      let activeReader = null;
      let stopRequested = false;
      let runCount = 0;
      let appliedMin = Infinity;
      let appliedMax = -Infinity;
      let sensedMin = Infinity;
      let sensedMax = -Infinity;
      let appliedMinIndex = -1;
      let appliedMaxIndex = -1;
      let sensedMinIndex = -1;
      let sensedMaxIndex = -1;
      let selectedSampleIndex = null;
      const themeToggle = document.querySelector("#themeToggle");
      const chartTooltip = document.querySelector("#chartTooltip");

      function setTheme(theme) {
        const isDark = theme === "dark";
        document.documentElement.dataset.theme = isDark ? "dark" : "light";
        themeToggle.textContent = isDark ? "Light mode" : "Dark mode";
        themeToggle.setAttribute("aria-label", `Switch to ${isDark ? "light" : "dark"} mode`);
        localStorage.setItem("mosfet-theme", isDark ? "dark" : "light");
        drawPlot();
      }

      function setStatus(message, kind = "") {
        statusText.textContent = message;
        status.dataset.kind = kind;
      }

      function setConnected(connected) {
        connectionDot.classList.toggle("active", connected);
        connectionLabel.textContent = connected ? "SERIAL CONNECTED" : "SERIAL OFFLINE";
      }

      function renderTable() {
        const body = document.querySelector("#readingsBody");
        body.replaceChildren();
        if (!samples.length) {
          const row = body.insertRow();
          const cell = row.insertCell();
          cell.colSpan = 3;
          cell.className = "table-empty";
          cell.textContent = "No readings yet";
        } else {
          const firstVisibleIndex = Math.max(0, samples.length - tableRowLimit);
          for (let index = firstVisibleIndex; index < samples.length; index += 1) appendReadingRow(body, index);
        }
        updateReadout();
        drawPlot();
      }

      function appendReadingRow(body, index) {
        if (index === 0) body.replaceChildren();
        const sample = samples[index];
        const row = body.insertRow();
        row.insertCell().textContent = String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0");
        row.insertCell().textContent = sample.applied.toFixed(3);
        row.insertCell().textContent = sample.sensed.toFixed(3);
        if (body.rows.length > tableRowLimit) body.deleteRow(0);
      }

      function updateReadout() {
        document.querySelector("#tableCount").textContent = `${samples.length.toLocaleString()} total`;
        document.querySelector("#sampleMetric").innerHTML = `${samples.length.toLocaleString()} <small>readings</small>`;
        document.querySelector("#lastMetric").innerHTML = samples.length ? `${samples[samples.length - 1].sensed.toFixed(3)} <small>V</small>` : "-- <small>V</small>";
        document.querySelector("#rangeMetric").innerHTML = samples.length ? `${samples[0].applied.toFixed(1)}-${samples[samples.length - 1].applied.toFixed(1)} <small>V</small>` : "-- <small>V</small>";
        exportButton.disabled = samples.length === 0;
      }

      function getAxis(dataMin, dataMax) {
        let min = dataMin;
        let max = dataMax;
        if (min === max) {
          const spread = Math.max(Math.abs(min) * 0.1, 0.1);
          min -= spread / 2;
          max += spread / 2;
        }

        const padding = (max - min) * 0.08;
        const paddedMin = min - padding;
        const paddedMax = max + padding;
        const roughStep = (paddedMax - paddedMin) / 5;
        const magnitude = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(roughStep));
        const fraction = roughStep / magnitude;
        const niceFraction = fraction <= 1 ? 1 : fraction <= 2 ? 2 : fraction <= 5 ? 5 : 10;
        const step = niceFraction * magnitude;
        const axisMin = dataMin >= 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(paddedMin / step) * step) : Math.floor(paddedMin / step) * step;
        const axisMax = Math.ceil(paddedMax / step) * step;

        return { min: axisMin, max: axisMax > axisMin ? axisMax : axisMin + step, step };
      }

      function getPlottedSamples() {
        if (samples.length <= chartPointLimit) return samples;
        const lastIndex = samples.length - 1;
        const indices = new Set([0, lastIndex, appliedMinIndex, appliedMaxIndex, sensedMinIndex, sensedMaxIndex]);
        for (let point = 0; point < chartPointLimit; point += 1) {
          indices.add(Math.round(point * lastIndex / (chartPointLimit - 1)));
        }
        return Array.from(indices).sort((left, right) => left - right).map(index => samples[index]);
      }

      function formatTick(value, step) {
        const decimals = Math.max(0, Math.min(6, -Math.floor(Math.log10(step))));
        return value.toFixed(decimals);
      }

      function drawPlot() {
        const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!bounds.width || !bounds.height) return;
        const ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = Math.round(bounds.width * ratio);
        canvas.height = Math.round(bounds.height * ratio);
        context.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
        context.clearRect(0, 0, bounds.width, bounds.height);

        const width = bounds.width - plotPadding.left - plotPadding.right;
        const height = bounds.height - plotPadding.top - plotPadding.bottom;
        const appliedAxis = samples.length ? getAxis(appliedMin, appliedMax) : getAxis(0, 5);
        const sensedAxis = samples.length ? getAxis(sensedMin, sensedMax) : getAxis(0, 5);
        const plottedSamples = getPlottedSamples();
        const palette = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
        const chartAxis = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-axis").trim();
        const chartGrid = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-grid").trim();
        const chartLabel = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-label").trim();
        const chartLine = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-line").trim();
        const chartPointFill = palette.getPropertyValue("--chart-point-fill").trim();
        context.font = '10px Consolas, monospace';
        context.textAlign = "right";
        context.textBaseline = "middle";
        const sensedTickCount = Math.round((sensedAxis.max - sensedAxis.min) / sensedAxis.step);
        for (let index = 0; index <= sensedTickCount; index += 1) {
          const tick = sensedAxis.min + index * sensedAxis.step;
          const y = plotPadding.top + height - ((tick - sensedAxis.min) / (sensedAxis.max - sensedAxis.min)) * height;
          context.beginPath();
          context.strokeStyle = index === 0 ? chartAxis : chartGrid;
          context.lineWidth = 1;
          context.moveTo(plotPadding.left, y);
          context.lineTo(plotPadding.left + width, y);
          context.stroke();
          context.fillStyle = chartLabel;
          context.fillText(formatTick(tick, sensedAxis.step), plotPadding.left - 10, y);
        }
        context.textAlign = "center";
        const appliedTickCount = Math.round((appliedAxis.max - appliedAxis.min) / appliedAxis.step);
        for (let index = 0; index <= appliedTickCount; index += 1) {
          const tick = appliedAxis.min + index * appliedAxis.step;
          const x = plotPadding.left + ((tick - appliedAxis.min) / (appliedAxis.max - appliedAxis.min)) * width;
          context.beginPath();
          context.strokeStyle = chartGrid;
          context.moveTo(x, plotPadding.top);
          context.lineTo(x, plotPadding.top + height);
          context.stroke();
          context.fillStyle = chartLabel;
          context.fillText(formatTick(tick, appliedAxis.step), x, plotPadding.top + height + 16);
        }
        const pointX = value => plotPadding.left + ((value - appliedAxis.min) / (appliedAxis.max - appliedAxis.min)) * width;
        const pointY = value => plotPadding.top + height - ((value - sensedAxis.min) / (sensedAxis.max - sensedAxis.min)) * height;
        if (samples.length) {
          context.beginPath();
          plottedSamples.forEach((sample, index) => {
            const x = pointX(sample.applied);
            const y = pointY(sample.sensed);
            if (index === 0) context.moveTo(x, y);
            else context.lineTo(x, y);
          });
          context.strokeStyle = chartLine;
          context.lineWidth = 2;
          context.stroke();
          plottedSamples.forEach(sample => {
            context.beginPath();
            context.arc(pointX(sample.applied), pointY(sample.sensed), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            context.fillStyle = chartPointFill;
            context.fill();
            context.strokeStyle = chartLine;
            context.lineWidth = 1.5;
            context.stroke();
          });
        }
        context.save();
        context.fillStyle = chartLabel;
        context.font = '11px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        context.textAlign = "center";
        context.textBaseline = "middle";
        context.fillText("applied voltage", plotPadding.left + width / 2, bounds.height - 7);
        context.translate(13, plotPadding.top + height / 2);
        context.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
        context.fillText("sensed voltage", 0, 0);
        context.restore();

        canvas.classList.toggle("has-data", samples.length > 0);
        if (selectedSampleIndex !== null && samples[selectedSampleIndex]) {
          const sample = samples[selectedSampleIndex];
          const x = pointX(sample.applied);
          const y = pointY(sample.sensed);
          context.beginPath();
          context.arc(x, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          context.strokeStyle = chartLine;
          context.lineWidth = 2;
          context.stroke();
          showTooltip(selectedSampleIndex, x, y);
        } else {
          chartTooltip.hidden = true;
        }
      }

      function showTooltip(index, x, y) {
        const sample = samples[index];
        const chartWrap = canvas.parentElement;
        const canvasBounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const wrapBounds = chartWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
        chartTooltip.textContent = `Reading ${index + 1}\nApplied voltage: ${sample.applied.toFixed(3)} V\nSensed voltage: ${sample.sensed.toFixed(3)} V`;
        chartTooltip.hidden = false;
        let left = canvasBounds.left - wrapBounds.left + x + 12;
        let top = canvasBounds.top - wrapBounds.top + y + 12;
        if (left + chartTooltip.offsetWidth > chartWrap.clientWidth - 8) left -= chartTooltip.offsetWidth + 24;
        if (top + chartTooltip.offsetHeight > chartWrap.clientHeight - 8) top -= chartTooltip.offsetHeight + 24;
        chartTooltip.style.left = `${Math.max(8, left)}px`;
        chartTooltip.style.top = `${Math.max(8, top)}px`;
      }

      function selectNearestSample(event) {
        if (!samples.length) return;
        const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = event.clientX - bounds.left;
        const y = event.clientY - bounds.top;
        const appliedAxis = getAxis(appliedMin, appliedMax);
        const sensedAxis = getAxis(sensedMin, sensedMax);
        const width = bounds.width - plotPadding.left - plotPadding.right;
        const height = bounds.height - plotPadding.top - plotPadding.bottom;
        let nearestIndex = -1;
        let nearestDistance = Infinity;

        samples.forEach((sample, index) => {
          const sampleX = plotPadding.left + ((sample.applied - appliedAxis.min) / (appliedAxis.max - appliedAxis.min)) * width;
          const sampleY = plotPadding.top + height - ((sample.sensed - sensedAxis.min) / (sensedAxis.max - sensedAxis.min)) * height;
          const distance = Math.hypot(sampleX - x, sampleY - y);
          if (distance < nearestDistance) {
            nearestDistance = distance;
            nearestIndex = index;
          }
        });

        selectedSampleIndex = nearestDistance <= 18 ? nearestIndex : null;
        drawPlot();
      }

      function addLine(line) {
        const values = line.trim().split(",");
        if (values.length !== 2) return;
        const applied = Number(values[0]);
        const sensed = Number(values[1]);
        if (!Number.isFinite(applied) || !Number.isFinite(sensed)) return;
        const index = samples.length;
        samples.push({ applied, sensed });
        if (applied < appliedMin) { appliedMin = applied; appliedMinIndex = index; }
        if (applied > appliedMax) { appliedMax = applied; appliedMaxIndex = index; }
        if (sensed < sensedMin) { sensedMin = sensed; sensedMinIndex = index; }
        if (sensed > sensedMax) { sensedMax = sensed; sensedMaxIndex = index; }
        appendReadingRow(document.querySelector("#readingsBody"), index);
        updateReadout();
        drawPlot();
        setStatus(`Receiving sample ${samples.length.toLocaleString()}...`);
      }

      function readWithTimeout(reader, milliseconds) {
        let timeoutId;
        return Promise.race([
          reader.read(),
          new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("No serial data received for 10 seconds.")), milliseconds);
          })
        ]).finally(() => window.clearTimeout(timeoutId));
      }

      async function capture() {
        if (!("serial" in navigator)) {
          setStatus("Web Serial is unavailable. Open this page in Chrome or Edge.", "error");
          return;
        }
        samples.length = 0;
        appliedMin = Infinity;
        appliedMax = -Infinity;
        sensedMin = Infinity;
        sensedMax = -Infinity;
        appliedMinIndex = -1;
        appliedMaxIndex = -1;
        sensedMinIndex = -1;
        sensedMaxIndex = -1;
        renderTable();
        stopRequested = false;
        runCount += 1;
        document.querySelector("#runNumber").textContent = String(runCount).padStart(3, "0");
        startButton.disabled = true;
        stopButton.disabled = false;
        setStatus("Choose the Arduino serial port...");
        let port;
        let reader;
        try {
          port = await navigator.serial.requestPort();
          await port.open({ baudRate: 115200 });
          setConnected(true);
          setStatus("Listening for voltage pairs...");
          const decoder = new TextDecoderStream();
          const decoderClosed = port.readable.pipeTo(decoder.writable).catch(() => {});
          reader = decoder.readable.getReader();
          activeReader = reader;
          let remainder = "";
          while (!stopRequested) {
            const { value, done } = await readWithTimeout(reader, 10000);
            if (done) break;
            remainder += value;
            const lines = remainder.split(/\r?\n/);
            remainder = lines.pop();
            for (const line of lines) {
              addLine(line);
            }
          }
          if (stopRequested) setStatus(`Capture stopped at ${samples.length.toLocaleString()} readings.`);
          else setStatus(`Serial stream ended after ${samples.length.toLocaleString()} readings.`, "error");
        } catch (error) {
          if (error.name === "NotFoundError") setStatus("No port selected.");
          else if (error.name === "AbortError" && stopRequested) setStatus(`Capture stopped at ${samples.length.toLocaleString()} readings.`);
          else setStatus(error.message || "Serial capture failed.", "error");
        } finally {
          activeReader = null;
          if (reader) {
            try { await reader.cancel(); } catch {}
            reader.releaseLock();
          }
          if (port?.readable) {
            try { await port.close(); } catch {}
          }
          setConnected(false);
          startButton.disabled = false;
          stopButton.disabled = true;
        }
      }

      startButton.addEventListener("click", capture);
      canvas.addEventListener("click", selectNearestSample);
      themeToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
        setTheme(document.documentElement.dataset.theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark");
      });
      stopButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (activeReader) {
          stopRequested = true;
          setStatus("Stopping capture...");
          activeReader.cancel();
        }
      });
      exportButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const csv = ["applied_voltage,sensed_voltage", ...samples.map(sample => `${sample.applied.toFixed(3)},${sample.sensed.toFixed(3)}`)].join("\n");
        const link = document.createElement("a");
        link.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" }));
        link.download = "mosfet-voltage-sweep.csv";
        link.click();
        window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href), 1000);
      });
      new ResizeObserver(drawPlot).observe(canvas);
      setTheme(localStorage.getItem("mosfet-theme") === "dark" ? "dark" : "light");
      renderTable();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

_**Agent (copilot/auto)**_

Found the cause: the tooltip kept its desktop position after the chart narrowed, and its initial placement only shifted once instead of clamping to the chart bounds. I’ll clamp it on every placement and redraw the plot on viewport resize so a selected point and its tooltip track the new layout.
